component.name: Eleven
component.summary: Dark grey windows, a dark panel with the apps in the middle

description.p: A dark style for the FlickOS desktop: neutral dark grey windows and title bars with wide, flat buttons drawn in thin lines (close turns red under the pointer), a sky blue accent, a near-black terminal, and folds of blue light on a deep blue wallpaper.

It comes with a layout of the same name: one see-through dark panel at the bottom with the apps button and your open windows in the middle, a line under each window and a blue one under the window you are using, and the status icons and a two-line clock at the right. The start menu opens above the middle of the panel. Use sets both; you can still pick another layout in Settings.

screenshot.caption: Files and a terminal in the Eleven style and layout
